purpose: Group related labeled form controls in a native fieldset with an associated description and responsive field layout.
behaviorProvider: Native fieldset/legend and ContentGrid; nested field controls and the surrounding host form retain their behavior.

component: native group semantics and description ids
native disabled boundary and explicit slot order
host: field values, names, labels and validation
portaled/custom-control disabled state and action semantics

requirements.statement: Render a native fieldset with the supplied legend as its first child. Render no nested form and add no synthetic form submission handler.
Give a present description a unique id and merge it with the caller aria-describedby through the shared deduplication helper.

Render direct children through ContentGrid, default maxColumns to one and minItemWidth to regular. Use its existing accepted column caps and minimum-width options and let it collapse with container width.
Forward disabled to the native fieldset and keep the field grid and optional action region inside it. Do not clone children or write disabled props into their component state.

Keep legend content noninteractive. Native fieldset rules exempt first-legend descendants and do not automatically cover portaled/custom widgets; pass explicit disabled props to those controls as needed.
Provide individual Field labels or other accessible names and native field names/constraints. A group legend and description do not replace each control label or validation message.
Own the action slot behavior. Set type=submit only for intentional submission of the surrounding form, and type=button for ordinary actions; the section does not supply Save/Cancel or reset policy.
Keep controlled drafts, validation, reset, loading/error/success state and data persistence in the form owner. Closing or disabling this group does not save, reset or validate fields.
Keep legend, description, field grid and actions in document order, with no added surface, sticky footer or child-control style overrides.
Use page-structure group tokens for owned type and spacing, preserve nested control token ownership, and keep geometry consistent across all four theme/mode mappings.

limitations: The disabled boundary is the native fieldset boundary, not an assurance that arbitrary portaled controls are disabled.
ContentGrid caps columns rather than forcing them; deeply nested fields remain the host composition responsibility.
No form element, validation engine, field-state store, persistence or automatic reset is provided.
